newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat closes lower on CBOT collapse.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat closes lower on CBOT collapse.

text.p: A fund-related collapse in CBOT wheat pressured MGE spring wheat futures to a lower close, traders said.
"The feature was Chicago taking out their lows," a trader said.
Hedge selling in early dealings also weighed on MGE spring wheat futures but scale-down commercial buying limited the slide.
Continental Grain was a key buyer of two million bushels of March on a scale-down basis, traders said.
Benson Quinn, Country Hedging and Wilson Trading each sold one million bushels of March, they said.
MGE spring wheat futures closed two to 5-1/4 cents per bushel lower, with March down 5-1/4 at $3.78.
